addVendor(bytes16).notice: Register vendor: one vendor per owner (EOA).

emitOrderEvent(bytes16,bytes16,bytes16,u.notice: Only registered Vendor contract or corresponding Order contract (that reports matching vendorId) is allowed to emit. Orders will call Vendor.notifyFabricFromOrder(...) which calls this function, so the simple require below (msg.sender == registered Vendor) is sufficient.

removeVendor(bytes16).notice: Allows vendor contract to unregister itself. Clears mapping for owner -> vendorId too.
